disambiguation: Not a general text editor; it specifically applies Knuth-Plass algorithms to the reading view layout.
extras: Fully offline, no network access, no telemetry, no ads, and no self-updating.
intentEvidence: Knuth-Plass optimal line-breaking for the Obsidian reading view.
problem: The default word-wrap in the reading view often results in visually uneven paragraphs and poor typographic quality.

relations.evidence: This plugin bundles @chenglou/pretext (MIT) for Canvas-based text measurement.

summary: Implements Knuth-Plass optimal line-breaking and text justification for the Obsidian reading view, replacing default word-wrap with typographically superior layout.
